text.issuer: HUNT J B TRANSPORT SERVICES INC

records.title: FORM 10-K
records.text: Fuel surcharge revenues decreased 27.4% to $757 million in 2020, compared to $1.04 billion in 2019.

records.title: FORM 10-K
records.text: Our total consolidated operating revenues increased 5.1% to $9.64 billion in 2020, compared to $9.17 billion in 2019, primarily due to increased ICS revenue per load, the December 2019 acquisition and new contractual business onboarded throughout 2020 in FMS, and increased load volumes in JBT and DCS.

records.title: FORM 10-K
records.text: Our 2020 consolidated operating expenses increased 5.8% from 2019, while year-over-year revenue increased 5.1%, resulting in a 2020 operating ratio of 92.6% compared to 92.0% in 2019.

records.title: FORM 10-K
records.text: Therefore, the reported amounts of assets, liabilities, revenues, expenses and associated disclosures of contingent liabilities are affected by these estimates.

records.title: FORM 10-K
records.text: Operating income of the JBI segment decreased to $428 million in 2020, from $447 million in 2019.
